prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-resolution 16:9 CRT hero background material for a responsive web interface
Input image: The approved “Layered Trace Ledger” composition is a material reference only. Preserve its near-black curved CRT glass, restrained horizontal scanlines, subtle P1 phosphor-green edge bloom, analog micrograin, and faint route-history afterimages. Do not reproduce any of its text, UI, diagrams, nodes, icons, panels, controls, metrics, logos, or claims.
Primary request: Create one production-ready, edge-to-edge curved CRT glass background field that visibly reads as physical CRT material in the first viewport. The center must remain dark, calm, and low-contrast so semantic phosphor-green HTML and SVG linework stays clear.
Scene/backdrop: A deep near-black convex CRT screen surface viewed straight-on, with softly darkened curved corners and a subtle glass perimeter.
Subject: Material only. Fine horizontal scanlines cover the full frame. Subtle phosphor-green bloom traces the curved perimeter and recedes toward the quiet center. Add microscopic analog grain and a sparse field of extremely faint, non-semantic horizontal route afterimages that dissolve before forming any readable diagram. Afterimages may be short broken horizontal traces and diffuse ghost bands, never connected nodes or identifiable interface geometry.
Style/medium: Photographic CRT glass material, understated, tactile, atmospheric, production-ready, not an illustration and not a UI mockup.
Composition/framing: Exact 16:9 landscape, edge-to-edge, no browser chrome, no separate frame object, no inset panel. Use a gentle convex-screen curvature. Keep the central 60 percent visually quiet with low bloom and no focal point. Perimeter effects may be strongest within the outer 12 percent.
Lighting/mood: Very dark, restrained phosphor persistence, subtle analog depth. No bright hotspot.
Color palette: Near-black, charcoal black, and muted P1 phosphor green only.
Materials/textures: Curved CRT glass, fine horizontal scanlines, soft perimeter bloom, subtle micrograin, faint phosphor persistence, faint non-semantic horizontal route afterimages.
Constraints: Opaque image; at least 1672 x 941 pixels or the closest larger native 16:9 output; no text; no letters; no numbers; no pseudo-text; no UI controls; no nodes; no icons; no logos; no metrics; no claims; no buttons; no panels; no diagrams; no circuitry; no grid; no border frame; no watermark. The center must support crisp green linework.
Avoid: readable symbols, connected routes, bright green lines, centered glow, vignettes that crush the center, blue or orange color, chromatic aberration, reflections, scratches, fingerprints, dust clumps, large speckles, moire, thick bands, strong gradients, glassmorphism, generic sci-fi HUDs.
